scenario_conditions: Current F01-F05 remain unresolved. The hypothetical calculation assumes all five fixes and original reproduction/acceptance checks have succeeded in a future snapshot.
W00-W14 and technical W20 complete, including authorized live model/host acceptance, production migration/rollback and realistic performance/cost measurement in declared scope.

All30 applicable technical criteria receive real evidence for at least anchor3; five explicitly listed anchors4 require High-confidence boundary/failure/countercheck evidence. No score is awarded for implementation intent alone.
Criterion-specific planned verification must be observed. Unsupported criteria remain unknown or are scored lower at re-evaluation;80 is not guaranteed.
No unresolved confirmed High or Critical findings, no unresolved severe suspicions; no relaxed tests, excluded criteria, changed profile/weights or task-specific semantic branches.
Live model credentials, explicit cost/call/time budgets, actual host authorization and workload thresholds are supplied before dependent execution. This planning task executes none of them.

W06 direct Claude Messages API and OpenAI Responses API gpt-6-luna both pass provider-specific schema, safety, fixed32-task and real-host acceptance under explicit shared/provider/judge budgets. Existing Claude Agent SDK fixture success is not direct API evidence. API tests have not been run.
